Food and Drug Administration accepted the New Drug Application with Priority Review for tinlarebant for the treatment of Stargardt disease type 1; Prescription Drug User Fee Act target action date of February 12, 2027 · If approved, tinlarebant would be the first-ever approved treatment for Stargardt Disease Type 1 and could become the first Sakigake pharmaceutical product for ophthalmology disease in Japan SAN DIEGO, Sept. 8, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Belite Bio , Inc (NASDAQ: BLTE) (“Belite Bio ® ” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage drug development company focused on advancing novel therapeutics targeting degenerative retinal diseases that have significant unmet medical needs, today announced the submission of a New Drug Application (NDA) to the Ministry of Health, Labour, and Welfare (MHLW) in Japan for tinlarebant in Stargardt disease type 1 (STGD1).
